newsitem.title: USA: Bally Total Fitness names Hillman CEO.
newsitem.headline: Bally Total Fitness names Hillman CEO.

text.p: Bally Total Fitness Holding Corp said Tuesday it has appointed Lee Hillman president and chief executive officer.
Hillman replaces Mike Lucci, whio has decided to retire as president but will remain a member of the board of directors, the company said.
Hillman has been executive vice president of Bally Total Fitness, as well as executive vice president, chief financial officer and treasurer of Bally Entertainment Corp.
He will retain his current position with Bally Entertainment until its merger with Hilton Hotels Corp is completed later this year, Bally Total Fitness said.
Bally Total Fitness, the largest commercial operator of fitness centers in the United States, was spun off from casino and hotel operator Bally Entertainment in 1995.
